question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR lock flow, the redesigned lock dialog drops the "Locked by" handle field and unlock drops the amendment note, yet Preview/View reuse src/views/LockedView.tsx which renders a "Locked by {handle}" provenance line and an Amendments audit section; what value should Snapshot.lockedBy now hold, and should the "Locked by" line and the amendments audit trail be removed, hidden, or retained?
recommendation: Set Snapshot.lockedBy to null on newly locked snapshots (keep the existing `string | null` type), and do NOT delete the LockedView rendering — instead make the "Locked by" provenance line conditionally HIDDEN when lockedBy is null, and RETAIN the Amendments section unchanged (it already renders nothing when the array is absent/empty). This drops the dead fields from the redesigned flow while still faithfully rendering already-locked historical snapshots that carry a handle and/or amendments.
supporting_points: The app has no auth/identity/session concept — lockedBy was populated solely from the free-text handle field the redesign removes (MbrBuilderView.doLock uses `handle.trim()`), so there is no meaningful value left to write; null is the correct, type-compatible default already permitted by shared/types.ts (`lockedBy: string | null`) and used for drafts.

Snapshots are immutable and self-contained (ADR-004), and committed data like data/snapshots/2026-07-27.0.json already has `lockedBy: "r.ferguson"` plus potential amendments; hard-removing the render code would drop provenance for existing locked MBRs, so hiding-when-null (not deleting) preserves faithful historical rendering.

LockedProvenance currently forces `snapshot.lockedBy ?? '—'`, so a null value would print a meaningless "Locked by —"; guarding that one span (render only when lockedBy is truthy) avoids UI noise, while Amendments is already correctly conditional (`if (!amendments || amendments.length === 0) return null`) and needs no change — new locks simply produce an empty trail.
